messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps.io deployment using ggpot2 is slightly pixelated
parts:
On shinyapps.io the Cairo library is not used for rendering by default, which means ggplot outputs are not anit-aliased. You can force Cairo used by including:

library(Cairo)

in your server.R

-Andy

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps.io deployment using ggpot2 is slightly pixelated
parts:
Just a little bit clarification: the png() device does use cairo for
anti-aliasing, and it is just that it does not work well for certain
point symbols, such as the (unfortunate?) default point shape (solid
point without border) in ggplot2. More info here:
http://r.789695.n4.nabble.com/png-type-cairo-point-symbols-without-boarders-are-not-anti-aliased-td4678745.html

So you may either use Cairo, or change the point shape in your plot.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
